cohort: The study included women who gave birth through in vitro fertilization using fresh embryo transfer in Korea between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) was associated with a decreased incidence of low birth weight and an increased incidence of macrosomia, transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN), and respiratory distress syndrome (RDS).
mod_finding: The OHSS group exhibited significantly higher rates of cesarean section (75.8% vs. 65.75%, p < 0.0001) compared to the non-OHSS group.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome (low birth weight and macrosomia)
